place.name: Cathedral of Santo Domingo
place.description: The Cathedral of the Americas, Cathedral of Santo Domingo, Cathedral Basilica of Santa María la Menor or Minor Basilica of Santa María de la Encarnación, officially known as the Minor Cathedral Basilica of Our Lady Saint Mary of the Incarnation or Annunciation (Spanish: Basílica Catedral Menor Nuestra Señora Santa María de la Encarnación o Anunciación), in the Colonial City of Santo Domingo is dedicated to St. Mary of the Incarnation.
